# BatteryIncluded Symfony Bundle – integration guide for AI agents

> Everything needed to add BatteryIncluded search to a Symfony shop with `batteryincluded/batteryincluded-bundle`.
> Follow the steps in order. Human-readable docs: https://bundle.batteryincluded.eiling.io/
> The bundle wraps the PHP SDK, its guide covers DTOs, translations and availability in depth:
> https://eiling-io.github.io/batteryincluded-php-sdk/llms-full.txt

## 0. Ask the user for

1. The collection name, always prefixed with `customer.` (e.g. `customer.my-shop`).
2. The API key of that collection. Store it in `.env.local`, a Symfony secret or the server environment, never in a
   committed file or the browser.
3. The entities to export (products, blog posts, …) and the languages and countries of the shop.
4. Whether the collection may be fully replaced: `bi:export` deletes all documents that are not exported.

## 1. Install and enable

```bash
composer require batteryincluded/batteryincluded-bundle
```

The Flex recipe (contrib, confirm it or set `extra.symfony.allow-contrib`) registers the bundle and adds the empty
variables to `.env`. Without the recipe add to `config/bundles.php`:

```php
Batteryincluded\BatteryincludedBundle\BatteryincludedBundle::class => ['all' => true],
```

```dotenv
# .env.local
BATTERYINCLUDED_COLLECTION=customer.my-shop
BATTERYINCLUDED_API_KEY=...
```

Verify: `bin/console bi:status` exits with 0 and shows the number of documents.

## 2. Data providers

One service per document kind implementing `Batteryincluded\BatteryincludedBundle\Provider\PartialDataProviderInterface`
(extends `DataProviderInterface`, tagged automatically):

```php
use Batteryincluded\BatteryincludedBundle\Provider\PartialDataProviderInterface;
use BatteryIncludedSdk\Dto\ProductBaseDto;

final class ProductProvider implements PartialDataProviderInterface
{
    public function __construct(private ProductRepository $products)
    {
    }

    // full export, page by page
    public function getBatches(int $batchSize): \Generator
    {
        foreach ($this->products->iterateActive($batchSize) as $products) {
            yield array_map($this->toDto(...), $products);
        }
    }

    // single documents, $ids are document ids like PRODUCT-5, ignore other types, skip inactive products
    public function getByIds(array $ids): iterable
    {
        $productIds = array_map(static fn (string $id) => (int) substr($id, 8), array_filter($ids, static fn (string $id) => str_starts_with($id, 'PRODUCT-')));

        return array_map($this->toDto(...), $this->products->findActiveByIds($productIds));
    }

    private function toDto(Product $product): ProductBaseDto
    {
        $dto = new ProductBaseDto((string) $product->getId());   // document id PRODUCT-<id>
        $dto->setName($product->getName());
        $dto->setPrice($product->getPrice());
        // translations, availability per country, categories, properties: see the SDK guide

        return $dto;
    }
}
```

Rules: deliver only documents that should be searchable; the document id is `<TYPE>-<identifier>` from the
constructor, exported as `id` in the document root (`setId()` is deprecated and no longer exported); never load the
whole catalog into memory.

Other content (content pages, FAQ, stores) gets its own type: extend `BatteryIncludedSdk\Dto\AbstractTranslatableDto`,
pass the type to the parent constructor and serialize the fields to `_<TYPE>` (see the export docs, "Own document
types"). Configure the fields in the schema of the collection in the BatteryIncluded backend.

## 3. First export

```bash
bin/console bi:export --dry-run   # serializes everything, reports duplicate ids, sends nothing
bin/console bi:export --force     # full import, deletes all documents that are not exported
```

The export stops before the commit on API errors, rejected documents or zero documents, the collection is then
unchanged. Use `--provider=ProductProvider` to create/replace one provider's documents without deleting anything.

## 4. Keep the collection up to date

Doctrine (DoctrineBundle installed): mark the entities, the bundle syncs after each successful flush and sends all
changes at the end of the request.

```php
use Batteryincluded\BatteryincludedBundle\Doctrine\Attribute\BatteryIncludedDocument;

#[ORM\Entity]
#[BatteryIncludedDocument('PRODUCT', deleteMissing: true)]   // deleteMissing: getByIds() not returning it deletes it
class Product {}

#[ORM\Entity]
#[BatteryIncludedDocument('PRODUCT', identifier: 'getProductId', deleteOnRemove: false)]
class Variant {}
```

With symfony/messenger the changes are dispatched as `SyncDocumentsMessage` / `DeleteDocumentsMessage`, route both to
an async transport:

```yaml
framework:
    messenger:
        routing:
            'Batteryincluded\BatteryincludedBundle\Messenger\SyncDocumentsMessage': async
            'Batteryincluded\BatteryincludedBundle\Messenger\DeleteDocumentsMessage': async
```

Without Doctrine call `Batteryincluded\BatteryincludedBundle\Sync\DocumentChangeQueue::scheduleSync('PRODUCT-5')` /
`scheduleDelete()` (sent at the end of the request) or `DocumentSynchronizer::syncByIds()` (sent now).

## 5. Search page

```php
use Batteryincluded\BatteryincludedBundle\Http\Attribute\MapSearchStruct;
use BatteryIncludedSdk\Shop\BrowseSearchStruct;
use BatteryIncludedSdk\Shop\BrowseService;

#[Route('/search')]
public function search(
    #[MapSearchStruct(perPage: 24, sortings: ['', '_PRODUCT.price:asc', '_PRODUCT.price:desc'])] BrowseSearchStruct $searchStruct,
    BrowseService $browseService,
): Response {
    return $this->render('search.html.twig', ['searchStruct' => $searchStruct, 'result' => $browseService->browse($searchStruct)]);
}
```

Query parameters: `q`, `f[field][]=value`, `f[field][from]=1&f[field][till]=9`, `sort`, `page`, `per_page`. The
locale is the request locale. `result.hits[].document._PRODUCT` holds the resolved fields, `result.getFacets()` the
facets, `result.found` the number of hits.

Search-as-you-type: import `@BatteryincludedBundle/config/routes/suggest.yaml` (`GET /batteryincluded/suggest?q=`,
suggestions grouped by type) and use the Stimulus controller of the bundle (Symfony UX registers it):

```twig
<form action="{{ path('search') }}" style="position: relative"
      {{ stimulus_controller('@batteryincluded/batteryincluded-bundle/suggest', {url: path('batteryincluded_suggest'), locale: app.request.locale, currency: 'EUR'}) }}>
    <input type="search" name="q" {{ stimulus_target('@batteryincluded/batteryincluded-bundle/suggest', 'input') }}>
</form>
```

Implement `Batteryincluded\BatteryincludedBundle\Document\DocumentUrlResolverInterface::resolve($id, $type, $data)` to
link the suggested documents to your routes (`$id` = `PRODUCT-5`). Suggested documents contain only the fields
selected under Suggest in the backend: select `id`, the title and optionally `imageUrl`, `price`, `teaser`.

Twig (with TwigBundle): `bi_search(query, {type, filters, sort, per_page})`, `bi_recommendations('PRODUCT-5', 'together')`,
`bi_highlights()`, `bi_document_url(document)`, filter `|bi_highlight`. Failed calls return an empty result and are
logged (thrown in debug).

Prices per country: configure the availability scope, it is stored in the request attribute `_batteryincluded_availability`:

```yaml
batteryincluded:
    availability:
        hosts: { 'shop.ch': ch }
        locales: { de_CH: ch, de_AT: at, de: de }
```

## 6. Production settings

```yaml
batteryincluded:
    http_client: batteryincluded.http_client   # timeouts and retries
    write_timeout: 300                         # seconds for imports, the commit of a full import waits for indexing
    cache:
        enabled: true                          # presets, highlights, recommendations
framework:
    http_client:
        scoped_clients:
            batteryincluded.http_client:
                scope: 'https://api\.batteryincluded\.io/'
                timeout: 10
                retry_failed: { max_retries: 2 }
```

Failed and slow calls are logged to the `batteryincluded` channel. Schedule a full import (e.g. nightly) as safety
net next to the incremental sync, with cron (`bin/console bi:export --force --report=var/log/export.json`) or the
Symfony Scheduler (`composer require symfony/scheduler dragonmantank/cron-expression`, then consume
`scheduler_batteryincluded`):

```yaml
batteryincluded:
    export:
        schedule:
            - { cron: '0 3 * * *' }
```

`bin/console bi:diff` compares providers and collection without changing anything and exits with 1 on differences,
e.g. as nightly check.

## 7. Hooks

- `PreExportEvent`: `cancel($reason)` stops `bi:export`.
- `DocumentsEvent`: every batch of export and sync, `getDocuments()` / `setDocuments()` to enrich or filter; removed
  documents are deleted by a full import.
- `PostExportEvent`: `successful`, `documents`, `duration`, `result`, `error`, `report` (per provider and type) after
  the export.
- `SuggestEvent`: `getResult()` / `setResult()` to translate group labels or add fields to the suggestions.

## Tests of the application

```yaml
when@test:
    batteryincluded:
        in_memory_api: true
```

Use `Batteryincluded\BatteryincludedBundle\Test\BatteryIncludedAssertionsTrait` in a `KernelTestCase`/`WebTestCase`:
`addBatteryIncludedDocuments([...])` as fixtures, `assertBatteryIncludedDocumentExists('PRODUCT-5')`,
`assertBatteryIncludedDocumentCount(3, 'PRODUCT')`, `assertBatteryIncludedRequest('POST', '/documents/import')`.

## 8. Verification checklist

1. `bin/console bi:status` exits with 0.
2. `bin/console bi:export --dry-run` serializes the expected number of documents without duplicate warnings.
3. `bin/console bi:export --force` succeeds, `bi:status` shows the same number of documents.
4. `bin/console bi:search <term> --facets` returns hits with translated names and the expected facets.
5. Change an entity, reload: the BatteryIncluded profiler panel or the log shows the import call; `bi:search` shows
   the change.
6. The search page shows hits, filters, sorting and pagination; the profiler panel shows one browse call without
   errors.
7. The suggestions open while typing, grouped by type, and link to the detail pages.
8. `bin/console bi:diff` exits with 0 a few seconds after the export.
9. No API key in committed files, templates or JavaScript.
